funder_detail: Total construction cost as reported at opening. Other reporting found in this collection pass gives different figures for what may be different scope (a ₹247.41 cr civil contract to Simplex Infrastructure Limited, awarded ~February 2017; a separate ₹1,168 cr figure including ₹152 cr land acquisition) — neither of those two was independently confirmed against a fetchable source, so only this ₹298 cr figure is recorded; see project notes.
